name: add-reaction
description: Adds an emoji reaction to a Slack message. Takes the channel by name or id (list-channels lists them), the message's ts, which read-channel-history, read-thread and post-message answer, and the emoji's name.

channel.description: A channel name, with or without the leading #, or a channel id from list-channels.

messageTs.description: The ts of the message to react to, from read-channel-history, read-thread or post-message.

emoji.description: The emoji's name, such as thumbsup, with or without the surrounding colons.
